promo.title: The Paper Trail: A Survival Guide to Commodity Trading
promo.text: First physical deals usually go wrong in the same places: fake offers, bad documents or unhedged prices. This short video course walks through a deal end to end - counterparty checks, inspection, LCs, price confirmation - with a checklist for every step. The prologue is free to watch.
